nieuw.titel: Try a Scar-Veteran on a Carnosaur competitively
nieuw.tekst: For competitive Lizardmen, he recommends trying a Saurus Scar-Veteran on a Carnosaur if you have not played that option much.
nieuw.waarom: He rates the Carnosaur as an efficient choice: for about 300 points it brings Strength 7, Toughness 6, numerous attacks, Swiftstride and Terror, and can also do useful work against other monsters.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He is unsure it can win the game for you in the way a dragon can.

bronnen.citaat: a scar veteran version of the carnosur, then I would go for that for sure.

nieuw.titel: Keep a Slann despite its cost
nieuw.tekst: He recommends embracing the Slann Mage-Priest and making the most of it rather than leaving it out. He sees particular versatility in the Renegades version.
nieuw.waarom: He thinks giving up the Slann sacrifices too much. He finds it capable of staying alive, preserving a substantial investment in points.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He acknowledges that it is overcosted and does not do much.

bronnen.citaat: you just got to embrace the slan.

nieuw.titel: Consider a Cold One Oldblood without a Slann
nieuw.tekst: If skipping the Slann Mage-Priest or spending those points on a combat character, he thinks a Saurus Oldblood on a Cold One might be a worthwhile option.
nieuw.waarom: He considers its statistics very good for what you get and values the all-round charge options available to Lizardmen characters.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He finds the Oldblood harder to make work because the faction's magic items are poor.

bronnen.citaat: old blood on a cold one might actually be not that bad

nieuw.titel: Choose a Vanguard or Scout screening package
nieuw.tekst: At 2,000 points, he suggests a Vanguard screen using Jungle Swarms and two units of Skink Skirmishers. Alternatively, use Chameleon Skinks and two units of Skink Skirmishers as Scouts.
nieuw.waarom: He says these screeners let the army use movement tricks and potentially shooting in the early game.

bronnen.citaat: you can toggle between having the vanguard screen.

extraCitaten.citaat: Or you can run chameleon skinks and two units of normal skinks as scouts.

nieuw.titel: Consider Chameleon Skinks despite their higher cost
nieuw.tekst: He considers Chameleon Skinks good value as screeners even though they cost twice as much as regular Skinks.
nieuw.waarom: He particularly values Evasive and Ballistic Skill 4, including evading out of a forest after shooting and generally hitting on sixes rather than needing six-plus.

bronnen.citaat: an 11point chameleon skink is still good value.

extraCitaten.citaat: ballistic skill four are shockingly good for those points.

nieuw.titel: Choose Temple Guard with a Slann, Saurus without one
nieuw.tekst: Choose one main infantry anvil: he favours Temple Guard when taking a Slann Mage-Priest and considers Saurus Warriors a workable choice without one.
nieuw.waarom: He thinks Saurus Warriors and Temple Guard are too expensive to afford both in the same army.

bronnen.citaat: if you're running the slan, temple guard are probably better.

extraCitaten.citaat: If you're not, Saurus have now become okay.

nieuw.titel: Run Saurus Warriors in blocks of sixteen to twenty
nieuw.tekst: When using Saurus Warriors as the infantry anvil he describes, take a substantial block of roughly 16 to 20 models.
nieuw.waarom: He expects a block this size to take a lot of damage before it is worn down, and highlights its parry, Toughness 4 and four-plus armour.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that it costs more than a Horde infantry unit able to perform that role.

bronnen.citaat: 16 to 20 is going to do you pretty well.

nieuw.titel: Use an Ancient Stegadon as a central cornerstone
nieuw.tekst: He still recommends the Ancient Stegadon as a cornerstone of this kind of Lizardmen list, using its high Toughness to advance up the centre.
nieuw.waarom: He says Toughness 6 remains valuable because most shooting needs multiple shots to bring such a model down.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He warns that cannons may not struggle with that resilience. He also considers the Ancient Stegadon very expensive for a model that can be avoided and still has five wounds.

bronnen.citaat: I would see ancient stegodon carnosur as as the cornerstones

extraCitaten.citaat: run these guys up the center of the board

nieuw.titel: Use several Terror causers to force charge tests
nieuw.tekst: Consider fielding three or four Terror-causing models with Lizardmen and getting their charges off to exploit those tests.
nieuw.waarom: He says even Leadership 8 or 9 fails enough tests in the endgame to make Terror a significant strength.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that Undead do not have to take these tests.

bronnen.citaat: the lizard could easily put three or four terracauses on the table.

extraCitaten.citaat: to get those charges off, they are a strong point

nieuw.titel: Hide vulnerable flankers until they can attack from extreme angles
nieuw.tekst: Keep vulnerable Lizardmen flankers hidden and safe for a while, then use their Swiftstride speed to approach at extreme angles and hit the enemy's side with high Unit Strength.
nieuw.waarom: He says these units are vulnerable and need those side attacks to hit and break the enemy.

bronnen.citaat: You need to come in at extreme angles with these units.

extraCitaten.citaat: You got to hide them, keep them safe for a while,

nieuw.titel: Leave champions out of the flanking units
nieuw.tekst: For the Lizardmen flanking units he describes, leave out champions so challenges do not dilute the unit's attacks.
nieuw.waarom: He says their main strength is the number of attacks they bring, while they lack much armour piercing, so they need their maximum attacking potential.

bronnen.citaat: make sure that you don't run any champions in the unit

extraCitaten.citaat: because they will get challenged out

bron.citaat: that's the best thing that you can have on a wing

extraCitaten.citaat: 360 degree charge arcs with swift stride those models.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He again recommends combat characters with all-round charge options for the wings, here emphasising Swiftstride.

bron.citaat: by getting in the way, being unbreakable

extraCitaten.citaat: you've got your jungle swarms in core

aanvullingen.toelichting: He again advocates Jungle Swarms as Unbreakable blockers that hold enemy units up.

bron.citaat: take a hit have enough ranks to fall back in good order

aanvullingen.toelichting: He again assigns Saurus Warriors the anvil role, surviving a hit and holding space through orderly retreats.

bron.citaat: That can allow you to set up the flank charges

extraCitaten.citaat: Just knowing that you're going to fall back in good order.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He again recommends using a predictable Stubborn retreat to set up supporting flank charges.
